'''Potpourri Island''' (Japanese: '''ポプリ島''' ''Potpourri Island'') is an {{pkmn|animated series}}-exclusive location south of the [[Kanto]] mainland. It is accessible by boat from [[Fuchsia City]]. There is a town on one side of the island, called [[Wisteria Town]].

==In animation==
[[File:Potpourri Island map.png|thumb|left|200px|Potpourri Island's map]]
Following {{Ash}}'s [[Battle Pike]] victory, the group arrived on Potpourri Island in ''[[AG159|Off the Unbeaten Path]]''. The group and {{TRT}} participated in the annual [[Pokémon Orienteering]] event alongside one of their Pokémon in a race to find stamps at five checkpoints across the island. [[James]] and {{TP|James|Mime Jr.}} managed to win the competition and earn the large food prize, which he gave away to Ash and friends for saving the [[Pokémon Center]] Nursery's Pokémon from [[Jessie]] and {{MTR}}'s clutches.

In the [[AG160|next episode]], Ash and his friends traveled to the other side of the island in order to reach Wisteria Town, where a [[Pokémon Contest]] was going to take place. {{an|May}}, her [[rival]] [[Harley]], and several other {{pkmn|Coordinator}}s entered the event hoping to win the coveted Wisteria [[Ribbon]]. May and Harley were pitched against one another in the final round, and Harley managed to defeat her {{TP|May|Munchlax}} using his {{p|Octillery}}, thus winning the competition and earning his fourth Kanto [[Ribbon]].

==Trivia==
===Name origin===
A {{wp|potpourri}} is a mixture of dried plants, usually ones that are associated with pleasant fragrances. They are commonly used as air fresheners for domestic purposes.
